entities.name: Ronom Lake
entities.description: Immense sweet-water lake in the center of Terisiare, ruined by the Brothers' War and dried up in the Ice Age.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: War that devastated the lake and land.

entities.name: Gixian
entities.description: Holders of Ronom lands until driven out.

entities.name: First Talite Crusade
entities.description: Crusade that drove the Gixians out around 69 AR.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: Co-founder of a school of magic and artifice by the Lake.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Co-founder of a school of magic and artifice by the Lake.

entities.name: Ronom Glacier
entities.description: Glacier whose meltwater fed the lake.

entities.name: Ice Age
entities.description: Time when the lake dried up.

entities.name: Frost Marsh
entities.description: Marsh that came into being east of the former lake.

entities.name: Tresserhorn
entities.description: Dark keep near the Frost Marsh.

events.summary: The Gixians are driven from Ronom around 69 AR in the First Talite Crusade.
events.quote: until they were driven out around 69 AR in the First Talite Crusade

events.summary: By 80 AR Ashnod and Tawnos found a school of magic and artifice along the lake.
events.quote: a school of magic and artifice was founded along the Lake by Ashnod and Tawnos

events.summary: During the Ice Age the remainder of the lake dries up as the Ronom Glacier no longer provides meltwater.
events.quote: the remainder of the lake dried up

relations.note: It lay in the center of the continent.
relations.quote: an immense lake in the center of the continent of Terisiare
